bibl.title: Osservazioni su alcune tavolette scolastiche: T. Varie 4-5, 6 e SB XXVI 16603.
bibl.seg: Donato Marazzi, Osservazioni su alcune tavolette scolastiche: T. Varie 4-5, 6 e SB XXVI 16603.
bibl.note: Points out a few common features within the group of school-tablets T. Varie 1-13; it may also be argued that T. Varie 4-5, 6 and S.B. XXVI, 16603 [= O. Cair. Mus. Copte Inv. 1006 (4079)] were written by the students of a same school, through the analysis of material, graphic and conceptual features of the three objects. Some remarks are proposed about the method of teaching the syllables and the word-formation in the Byzantine school.
